set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "42ab06f5d545d261814a52bd2fb923e7fc83f847"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

req = Path("backend/requirements.txt")
expected = '''fastapi==0.139.0
starlette==1.3.1
uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0
sqlmodel==0.0.22
alembic==1.14.0
Pillow==12.2.0
mutagen==1.47.0
python-multipart==0.0.31
pytest==9.0.3
httpx==0.28.1
ruff==0.8.4
coverage==7.6.10
schemathesis==4.21.5
'''
current = req.read_text()
if current != expected:
    raise SystemExit("backend/requirements.txt changed unexpectedly")
runtime = '''fastapi==0.139.0
starlette==1.3.1
uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0
sqlmodel==0.0.22
alembic==1.14.0
Pillow==12.2.0
mutagen==1.47.0
python-multipart==0.0.31
'''
dev = '''-r requirements.txt

pytest==9.0.3
httpx==0.28.1
ruff==0.8.4
coverage==7.6.10
schemathesis==4.21.5
'''
req.write_text(runtime)
Path("backend/requirements-dev.txt").write_text(dev)

ci = Path(".github/workflows/ci.yml")
s = ci.read_text()
old = "          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements.txt\n"
new = "          cache-dependency-path: |\n            backend/requirements.txt\n            backend/requirements-dev.txt\n"
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit("CI cache dependency path not found")
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
old = "python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt"
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit("CI install command not found")
s = s.replace(old, "python -m pip install -r backend/requirements-dev.txt", 1)
ci.write_text(s)

pack = Path(".github/workflows/sandbox-pack.yml")
s = pack.read_text()
old = "            sha256sum backend/requirements.txt\n            sha256sum backend/pyproject.toml\n"
new = "            sha256sum backend/requirements.txt\n            sha256sum backend/requirements-dev.txt\n            sha256sum backend/pyproject.toml\n"
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit("Sandbox dependency hash block not found")
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
old = "-r backend/requirements.txt"
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit("Sandbox wheel requirements command not found")
s = s.replace(old, "-r backend/requirements-dev.txt", 1)
pack.write_text(s)

bootstrap = Path("tools/sandbox/bootstrap-sandbox.sh")
s = bootstrap.read_text()
old = '-r "$REPO_ROOT/backend/requirements.txt"'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit("Sandbox bootstrap requirements command not found")
bootstrap.write_text(s.replace(old, '-r "$REPO_ROOT/backend/requirements-dev.txt"', 1))

doc = Path("docs/SANDBOX_EXECUTION_FLOW.md")
s = doc.read_text()
old = "- `backend/requirements.txt`;\n- `backend/pyproject.toml`;\n"
new = "- `backend/requirements.txt`;\n- `backend/requirements-dev.txt`;\n- `backend/pyproject.toml`;\n"
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit("Sandbox dependency-input docs block not found")
doc.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
PY

grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=node_modules -E 'backend/requirements(-dev)?\.txt' .github docs tools scripts README.md backend 2>/dev/null || true
git diff --check
git status --short

commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
RUNTIME_VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-runtime-venv-XXXXXX)
DEV_VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-dev-venv-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$RUNTIME_VENV" "$DEV_VENV"' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$RUNTIME_VENV"
"$RUNTIME_VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
"$RUNTIME_VENV/bin/python" -m pip check
PYTHONPATH=backend CLAIM_TOKEN_SECRET=focused-runtime-secret "$RUNTIME_VENV/bin/python" - <<'PY'
from app.main import app
from app.core.config import get_claim_token_secret
assert app is not None
assert get_claim_token_secret() == "focused-runtime-secret"
PY
if "$RUNTIME_VENV/bin/python" -m pip show pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "pytest unexpectedly present in runtime venv" >&2
  exit 1
fi
python3 -m venv "$DEV_VENV"
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements-dev.txt
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m pip check
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import coverage, httpx, pytest, ruff, schemathesis
print("dev imports ok")
PY
cd backend
CLAIM_TOKEN_SECRET=focused-dev-secret "$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m pytest app/tests/core/test_config.py app/tests/services/test_admin_memory_review_transactions.py
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m ruff format --check app ../server.py
"$DEV_VENV/bin/python" -m ruff check app ../server.py
cd ..
git diff --check
